Results.ReviewText: First time grill owner- this grill is easy to use. Food tastes great and clean up is quick. Helpful resources with purchase- guides to cooking. Terrific purchase
Results.Title: Fantastic grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill is the perfect size for my needs. I love that the sides both fold down for storage when not in use in the winter. The grill is well made and of the highest quality. It is heavy duty and will last for years.
Results.Title: Superior Quality!

Results.ReviewText: Bought this a month ago and it cooks up a storm..works well..not disappointed at all..
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve only used it 3 times but I’m overall happy with it. It doesn’t get get past 400-425 degrees.
Results.Title: Doesn’t heat up past 400-425 degrees

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. It is just the right size for our family. It is well constructed, cleans easily and we've been very satisfied with its cooking performance. The easy-to-read thermometer embedded in the grill's cover makes temperature control very convenient.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: We purchased our first Weber grill to reflect our downsizing lifestyle. It seems to be the closest thing to perfect we have experienced in a grill, though it has only been 2 months. I like the ability to control the temperature, hot on one side and cooler on the other when needed. The assembly was no problem, follow the directions, for me though I am a bit mechanically inclined. I like that all four wheels swivel and lock. I am looking forward to the longevity of this grill.
Results.Title: Downsized

Results.ReviewText: I chose this grill on Lowe's website but didn't see it in person before the purchase.  The grill cooking area is relatively small but that was expected.  What wasn't expected were grids without a porcelain finish.  If you don't spray the grids before cooking raw meat, you're left with a stuck-on mess.  The purpose of my review to warn others about what I didn't consider.
Results.Title: Cooking Grids are Awful

Results.Title: Love it!

Results.Title: Perfect for small meals

Results.ReviewText: I love this bbq, it is well built and cooks evenly and I love how you can see how much propane is left
Results.Title: Vunderful

Results.ReviewText: Went shopping for an inexpensive grill but after seeing how truly cheap the quality really was, we decided to invest in something that will hopefully last longer and provide a better overall cooking experience.  The Spirit 210 is built with sturdy, great quality parts. Heats evenly, love that it is not too big and bulky and the folding side shelves are fantastic!
Results.Title: Investment in quality

Results.ReviewText: Wanted a Weber grill for a long time, so sad I waited. Great grill, holds heat well, and made to last. So excited about using this grill for years to come
Results.Title: Waited too long

Results.ReviewText: We had a Genesis Series for long time - and loved it. But after faithful service ...and a rebuild...it was time for a replacement.   We are empty nesters now and wanted something smaller - but were skeptical that nothing could live up to the Genesis.   How very wrong we were!  Our new Weber Spirit is absolutely fantastic!!  Heats up fast, cooks perfectly, great flavor to both meats and veges. The only drawback - and this is only because of my age and arthritis  - is the location of the gas canister.  Great for aestherics....just a challenge for me to replace. Thanks Weber for another great grill on my patio!!
Results.Title: Spirit is a Winner !!

Results.ReviewText: Heats quickly and efficiently.  Cooks beautifully.  I like the idea of the small drip pans underneath the flames.  The grills are easy to clean.
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: Love it!!! I already had one but had a house fire and lost the grill. Replaced it with the same exact grill!!!
Results.Title: Love Weber Grills!!!

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Weber Spirit Grill and we love it. We've tried many gas grills over the years and this is by far the best grill ever!!
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever!!

Absolutely the easiest grill i have ever assembled.   Every step was precisely perfect.
Grill cooks so well, i and family love it.

Results.ReviewText: We have not had a gas grill for a long time and decided to purchase the Weber Genesis E210. The grill was packaged very well, with great assembly instructions. Once completed, I did the initial burn off, and have been cooking on the grill a lot. This grill is fantastic, no flare ups, perfect heat, and easy to clean up. I cannot imagine owners g anything other than a Weber grill!

Results.ReviewText: WE bought this grill about a month ago and we love it.  It is sturdy and doesn't wobble. It is stainless steel and very heavy.  It cooks evenly and beautifully.  The two side trays are great for holding platters and extra plates. There are so many features on this grill! It's a must if you're looking for a high quality grill! And, it has a 10 year warranty !

This is a very well built Gas grill.
 I normally have to buy a grill every 2 and a 1/2 years but my neighbors always seem to have the same for 12 plus years. And it was always a Weber
  So I finally made the investment and very happy!

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
